headline: Drama Triangle, from entry to detail
overview: Identify when you fall into Victim, Persecutor, or Rescuer roles in conflicts. Based on the Karpman Drama Triangle, this tool helps you recognize dysfunctional relationship patterns and shift toward healthier dynamics.
targetAudience: Users interested in relationships tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Identify your default role in the Victim, Persecutor, or Rescuer triangle
Understand the dynamics of the Karpman Drama Triangle
Recognize conflict patterns in your relationships
Learn strategies to exit the drama triangle and adopt healthier roles
tips: Think of a recent conflict and honestly assess which role you defaulted to — awareness is the first step to change.
Remember that all three roles are disempowering; the goal is to exit the triangle entirely, not switch roles.
